main.summary: Configures the inactivity retention period, leader identity, cleanup polling interval, startup jitter, and candidate page size for transfer-session cleanup.

field.name: LeaderLockName
field.summary: Stable PostgreSQL advisory-lock name used to elect one transfer-session cleanup leader.

property.name: InactivityTimeout
property.summary: Gets or sets the inactivity age after which a transfer session can be considered for cleanup.

property.name: PollingInterval
property.summary: Gets or sets the interval between cleanup scans by the elected leader.

property.name: LeaderRetryInterval
property.summary: Gets or sets the maximum randomized delay before a follower retries acquiring cleanup leadership.

property.name: InitialJitterMaximum
property.summary: Gets or sets the maximum randomized delay before the first cleanup scan.

property.name: CandidatePageSize
property.summary: Gets or sets the maximum number of stale candidate rows loaded per page.
